title: Personal Time Capsule — capsule.yaml
description: Structural schema for a capsule's root tag file. See ../FORMAT.md for the field-by-field explanation and rationale. This schema covers ROADMAP.md items 7-8 (structure), 12 (privacy — see ../PRIVACY.md), and 13 (encryption — see ../ENCRYPTION.md). It deliberately does not encode the deeper semantics of access/release triggers (item 14) or custody/succession (item 15), still separate, not-yet-written model documents.

spec_version.description: The capsule format version this file conforms to, e.g. "PTC-0.1".

id.description: A stable, unique identifier for this capsule (e.g. a urn:uuid).

created.description: ISO 8601 date the capsule was originated (Lifecycle stage 1).

creator.description: Optional per Principle #2 — the creator controls what identifying information appears here at all, including whether this object is present.

purpose.description: Optional free-text framing of what this particular capsule is.

collections.description: Named groupings of payload content under data/. Optional — a capsule need not declare any.

access.description: Capsule-wide defaults that every collection inherits unless it overrides.

custody.description: Primary custodian and fallback succession chain (Threat Model #3, Actors — successor custodian). Optional — not every capsule has a custodian yet.

manifest_algorithm.description: Matches BagIt's manifest-sha256.txt / tagmanifest-sha256.txt. See STANDARDS.md.

lifecycle_stage.description: Which LIFECYCLE.md stage this capsule instance currently sits in.

description.description: Required when type is custom — free-text description of the policy, since custom has no other defined semantics yet (ROADMAP.md item 14).

encryption.description: Optional. Overrides the capsule-wide encryption block for this collection — a full replacement, not a merge, same convention as privacy_zone/release_policy overrides. See ENCRYPTION.md's "Encryption granularity" section for why a collection with its own release_policy generally needs its own key and trustee quorum too.
See ENCRYPTION.md (ROADMAP.md item 13). Public/immediate-release content is never encrypted; anything else gets XChaCha20-Poly1305 payload encryption with a SLIP-0039-split key.

algorithm.description: Required once status is "planned" or "encrypted". Locked to one vetted default rather than offering creator-selectable crypto-agility — see ENCRYPTION.md.

scheme.description: Currently only "quorum" is used in practice; left as a free string in case a future revision introduces others.

splitting_scheme.description: The secret-sharing mechanism splitting the encryption key across trustees. See ENCRYPTION.md.

trustees.description: Bookkeeping only — never the actual share material. See ENCRYPTION.md.

share_index.description: Which numbered share (of key_custody.quorum.of) this trustee holds, for bookkeeping only — not a substitute for the trustee independently confirming their own share.

custodian.description: Intentionally loose pending ROADMAP.md item 15 (custody/succession model) — 'institution' is the only role ACTORS.md currently defines, but this schema doesn't yet foreclose others.
